Specifically: 1) The claim states the method 'Overestimates extinction for index-matching materials due to the single interface/semi-infinite assumption'. This is confirmed in the notes and Figure 11 caption, which states: 'As we assume a single interface and semi-infinite material when computing scattering, our algorithm tends to overestimate extinction' for materials with a matching refraction index. 2) The claim states the method 'requires careful training on Segment-to-Point contributions to avoid overestimation'.
